page_title: CAD 0-1 GIR | Cadiz CF v Girona 07/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Solis Romero J. E. Knee Injury

commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cadiz CF.
90+4' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar.
90+2' Alvaro Negredo (Cadiz) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
90+2' Wonderful movement by Cadiz CF. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
90' Yellow card. Ibrahima Kebe (Girona) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
88' Today's match ends for Ivan Martin who will be replaced by Juanpe (Girona).
88' Michel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ibrahima Kebe (Girona) replacing Yangel Herrera.
88' Good team movement sets up Pablo Torre (Girona) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post.
87' Pablo Torre (Girona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
83' An attempted cross from Lucas Pires (Cadiz) is cleared.
83' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Cadiz CF.
82' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Ivan Alejo (Cadiz), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
79' Sergio decides to make a substitution. Jorge Mere will be replaced by Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alvaro Negredo (Cadiz) comes onto the pitch for Chris Ramos.
77' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
77' Eric Garcia (Girona) is caught offside!
74' Cadiz CF have been awarded a corner kick.
74' Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
73' A substitution has been made. Maximiliano Gomez is replaced by Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz).
73' Valery (Girona) collects a wonderful lead pass and creates some space to smash the ball goalwards from long range. His shot goes painfully wide of the left post!
72' Michel prepares a substitution. Savio is replaced by Valery (Girona).
72' It is time for a substitution. Cristhian Stuani (Girona) is on for Artem Dovbyk.
69' Cadiz CF force a corner. They send men into the box.
66' Substitution. Iza Carcelen makes way for Lucas Pires (Cadiz).
66' Here is a change. Gonzalo Escalante is going off and Sergio gives the last tactical orders to Rominigue Kouame (Cadiz).
64' Yan Couto (Girona) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Conan Ledesma makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pablo Torre (Girona) comes onto the pitch so that Miguel Gutierrez can be given a rest.
59' 0 - 1 Goal! Yan Couto plays a short, square pass into the path of Aleix Garcia (Girona), who bends a shot straight into the bottom right corner to make it 0:1. Fabulous goal!
58' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) is penalised for a foul. Juan Martinez Munuera had a clear view and blows his whistle.
57' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Artem Dovbyk (Girona) heads on.
52' Girona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
51' He should have scored! Savio (Girona) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom right corner is pretty weak and Conan Ledesma makes an easy save.
50' The attendance for today's match is 16438.
48' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
46' Daley Blind (Girona) attempts to find Yangel Herrera, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+11' Juan Martinez Munuera has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+11' Savio (Girona) receives a clever chip pass into a promising position. Nevertheless, one of the defenders is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
45+9' Girona have been awarded a corner kick.
45+4' What was Yangel Herrera (Girona) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
45' The fourth official shows 10 min. of added time.
44' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
43' Referee Juan Martinez Munuera signals NO PENALTY for Girona after a VAR review!
42' One of the Girona players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
41' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
39' Yan Couto (Girona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
36' Yan Couto (Girona) commits a foul and Juan Martinez Munuera immediately signals a free kick.
34' Cadiz CF will take a corner kick.
34' Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
33' A rebound sits up nicely for Fali (Cadiz) and he needs no second invitation to shoot from distance. The effort, however, balloons high over the bar and out for a goal kick.
32' The referee blows his whistle, Cadiz CF are awarded a corner kick.
31' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
31' Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle and it's David Lopez (Girona) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
30' Yan Couto (Girona) is able to continue to play.
27' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
27' Yan Couto (Girona) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
24' The ball is out of play and Girona manage to earn a corner.
24' Savio (Girona) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
21' The Girona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
18' Javi Hernandez (Cadiz) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Paulo Gazzaniga intercepts the ball.
17' Surely that's handball by one of the Girona players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
13' The VAR review is over and the red card for Darwin Machis (Cadiz) stands! Off he trudges.

11' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Darwin Machis (Cadiz), but referee Juan Martinez Munuera must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
10' Darwin Machis (Cadiz) is given his marching orders with a straight red card! For us, it was a very harsh one.
9' Yangel Herrera (Girona) plants his close-range header just wide of the left post after a cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Cadiz CF will have a goal kick.
5' The game is interrupted now, Yangel Herrera (Girona) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
5' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
4' Aleix Garcia (Girona) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
3' The referee points to the corner flag and Girona will take a corner.
3' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Girona, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
2' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Cadiz CF will have the kick-off.
Juan Martinez Munuera got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
